comment: Independent minion.c demon_talk() entry from monmove.c dochug(): a lawful Valkyrie wields a wished Demonbane and wears a wished helm of telepathy, then creates a peaceful Baalzebub. Baalzebub is invisible, so the hero senses it (display.h sensemon(), extrinsic telepathy within range) without seeing it. When it next moves beside the hero, demon_talk() tests canspotmon(mtmp), which is true, and prints "<Demon> looks very angry." rather than "You feel tension building.", then attacks.
